title_sq: PENTHOUSE PER SHITJE PRANE LIQENIT TE THATE! 310,000 € Sip. Totale 174m2
description_sq:
PENTHOUSE PER SHITJE PRANE LIQENIT TE THATE!
310,000 €
Sip. Totale 174m2
Ofrojme penthouse luksoz per shitje në zonën e Liqenit të Thatë, me pamje panoramike të Tiranës.
Apartamenti ka një sipërfaqe totale prej 174 m², nga te cilat 68 metra jane pjese e verandes dhe ofron komoditet, ndriçim natyral ne nje ndertim te ri me ashensor. Apartamenti ka nje organizim shume te mire, ne nje sallon te bollshem, kuzhine me vete,
2 dhoma gjumi, dhe 1 tualet.
Veranda e madhe eshte ideale për relaks per te kaluar momente me miqte dhe familjen.
Duke qene se ndodhet ne katin e fundit, apartamenti ka ndricim shume te mire.
Disponon dokumenta te rregullta pronesie.
title_en: PENTHOUSE FOR SALE NEAR THE DRY LAKE! €310,000 Ex. Total 174m2
description_en: PENTHOUSE FOR SALE NEAR THE DRY LAKE! €310,000 Ex. Total 174m2 We offer luxury penthouse for sale in the Dry Lake area, with a panoramic view of Tirana. The apartment has a total area of ​​174 m², of which 68 meters are part of the veranda and offers comfort, natural lighting in a new building with an elevator. The apartment has a very good organization, in a spacious living room, separate kitchen, 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. The large veranda is ideal for relaxing and spending moments with friends and family. Being located on the top floor, the apartment has very good lighting. Has regular ownership documents.
